description: Source file defining the BuzzComment entity class, which models comments within the Buzz plugin of the OrangeHRM HRM system, including properties, ORM mappings, and methods.

classes.name: BuzzComment
classes.description: Entity class representing a comment in the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin, including properties for comment details, associations with share and employee, and timestamp fields.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the BuzzComment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the BuzzComment.

methods.name: getShare
methods.description: Retrieves the BuzzShare associated with this comment.

methods.name: setShare
methods.description: Associates a BuzzShare with this comment.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee who authored the comment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee as the author of this comment.

methods.name: getNumOfLikes
methods.description: Gets the number of likes on this comment.

methods.name: setNumOfLikes
methods.description: Sets the number of likes for this comment.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation time in UTC to the current time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp in UTC, if any.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Updates the 'updated at' timestamp to the current time.
